key_insight: ReDiPPO improves mathematical reasoning by using a reference-guided critic for better value estimates and a discrepancy signal to reweight token-level training advantages.
engineering_relevance: The method targets a core RL failure mode in long-horizon reasoning—noisy credit assignment—making PPO-style training more reliable for LLMs on math tasks.
method: Train a reference-guided critic using privileged reference answers during training.
Keep a standard critic and measure the discrepancy between reference-guided and standard value estimates.
Use this discrepancy to reweight token-level advantages in PPO, emphasizing harder reasoning states.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive experiments on diverse mathematical reasoning benchmarks, with ReDiPPO improving value-estimation accuracy and outperforming PPO, DAPO, and GSPO in final reasoning performance.
watch_item: Because the approach relies on reference answers as training-time privileged signals, its setup may be harder to apply when high-quality references are unavailable or noisy.
paper_title: ReDiPPO: Reference-Guided Value Calibration and Discrepancy-Aware Token Reweighting for Mathematical Reasoning
